Callout.Name: Vehicle Fire
Callout.Message: Vehicle alight in a car park, one person overcome by smoke.
Callout.Advisory: Nobody in the vehicle, one casualty being kept back.
Callout.Patient: I was right next to it. My chest feels tight.

Lines.Approach: Nobody is in the car. One person took the smoke and is being kept clear.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
